tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (7.2:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: primary-blue
tokens.usage: Trust, care, medical professionalism. Used as text on `.nav-link:hover`, `.nav-link.active`, `.stat-icon.blue`; border on `.nav-link.active`. 5.7:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: clinical-white
tokens.usage: Cleanliness, precision, clarity. Used as text on `.header`, `.event-date`, `.btn-primary`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: soft-gray
tokens.usage: Comfortable clinical environment. Used as background on `body`.

tokens.name: text-navy
tokens.usage: Authority, expertise, stability. Used as text on `body`, `.page-title`, `.stat-value`. 9.0:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: healing-green
tokens.usage: Positive outcomes, growth, certification. Used as border on `.stat-card.green`; text on `.stat-icon.green`, `.trend-positive`, `.event-cme`. 3.6:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: clinical-red
tokens.usage: Urgent attention, critical alerts. Used as text on `.policy-status.urgent`. 4.6:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: warning-amber
tokens.usage: Used as border on `.stat-card.amber`; text on `.stat-icon.amber`, `.status-expiring`. 2.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: info-blue
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.badge-new`, `.status-pending`, `.policy-status`. 3.5:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: alert-info-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: background on `.alert-info`, `.badge-new`, `.status-pending`.

tokens.name: stat-icon-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: background on `.stat-icon.amber`, `.alert-warning`, `.status-expiring`.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero and page titles — as `h1` on the reference page.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section headings — as `h2.page-title` on the reference page.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Card and module titles — as `h3.card-title` on the reference page.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body copy — as `td` on the reference page.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels, eyebrows and table headers, set in uppercase — as `span.stat-label` on the reference page.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions and metadata — as `div.policy-meta` on the reference page.

styles.usage: Button labels — as `button.btn` on the reference page.
